# Feature: Orb bank — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #94 (Orb bank) from Orbs before it is used in real levels. Effect: gate counts orbs banked last level. Unique: orbs persist between levels, not just within one. Useful: rewards finishing earlier levels with orbs to spare. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** gate counts orbs banked last level.

**So that** rewards finishing earlier levels with orbs to spare.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Orb bank for the first time in its teaching room (mech-94-orb-bank-room). Teaching moment: First room: a level that ends with a visible bonus orb beside the warp, followed by a bank gate in the next level. A player who warps past the bonus arrives at the bank gate with nothing banked and must take the long way round, which teaches that what is banked in one level is spent in another. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: A higher-level campaign rule: bonus orbs you bank at a warp are remembered, and a later bank gate deducts from that bank instead of orbs in its own level
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The bank shows in the HUD between levels

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Orb bank's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-94-orb-bank-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/orbs.yml mechanic #94.
